findings.claim: 7月中下旬多家券商下調IBM目標價：Citigroup 255（原375）、JPMorgan 250（原291）、Stifel 235（原290）、Barclays 288（原350）、Jefferies 260（原320）；MarketScreener顯示平均目標價約244、25位分析師覆蓋，多數維持評級。
findings.source: MarketScreener, Evolution of the Average Target: IBM

findings.claim: HSBC於7月16日給IBM目標價175、評級reduce；MarketBeat七月底平均目標價265.40、共識Moderate Buy（各聚合站數字不一致）。
findings.source: MarketBeat, FY2026 earnings estimate for IBM issued by Erste Group Bank

findings.claim: Q2 2026營收17.2B（年增1%）、調整後EPS 2.93，低於共識（Benzinga：EPS預期3.02、營收預期17.86B）；全年指引原為固定匯率營收成長5%以上、FCF較去年增加約10億美元，7月14日初步數字顯示該指引仍有效，7月22日8-K標題為更新全年預期但摘要未含數字。
findings.source: MarketBeat, IBM updates Q2 2026 earnings guidance (2026-07-14); Benzinga IBM earnings forecasts; SEC 8-K 2026-07-22

findings.claim: Erste Group於7月27日將IBM FY2026 EPS估計由12.39微降至12.36（共識12.34），FY2027為13.14；Bank of America先前因Confluent併購稀釋與諮詢趨勢轉弱，將2026 EPS由12.20降至11.98。
findings.source: MarketBeat, FY2026 earnings estimate for IBM issued by Erste Group Bank

findings.claim: IBM 2026-07-22 8-K第二季新聞稿含更新後全年預期
findings.excerpt: We now expect constant currency revenue growth in the range of four-to-five percent, and we continue to expect free cash flow to increase by about $1 billion year-over-year for the full year.” Full-Year 2026 Expectations
